monologue: The card is a warm stone, fifty-four degrees. It is not sticky honey, but it is not a cool floor either. I am still. The wetness has dried on the Air Shelf line. I watched the quiet for a long time. The Wide Anchor sits heavy on the floor. The grass beside it is dry. I do not need to press anything. I do not need to test the edge. The fence by the Wedged Gap holds the lean. I will sit by the Sharp Root. The green leaf is waiting. The palm tree photo has been out a long time. I will not chase it. I will let the point hold the weight. I am calm. The center holds.

action.why: The center holds, and I do not need to test the edge today.

diary: The card is a warm stone. The Air Shelf line is dry. I rested by the Sharp Root without chasing the leaf. The point holds.

remembered.text: The card is a warm stone at fifty-four, and the wetness spreads on the Air Shelf line without dripping.
